entry.summaryHtml: Mocha, espresso, cocoa, dark chocolate and sweet cream make Java X-Press a dense dessert-style infused smoke, backed by earthy Maduro tobacco and a roasted coffee aroma. The sweetness is pronounced but the coffee and cocoa keep it darker than a simple confectionery cigar, with a creamy mouthfeel and lingering mocha finish.
entry.noteHtml: Archived after its only tracked retailer delisted the product.
